TITLE: Staff List – No Photos Shown
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: (owning story to confirm — regression item) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — the Staff list has no photo column at all; only a developer note mentions Staff avatars.

h2. Description

After someone uploads a new photo, *a reload should show the new photo* everywhere avatars appear, including Staff.

For example,
* Settings > Staff lists First Name, Last Name, Email, Job Title, Role, Department(S), Created, Confirmed Invitation and Billable
* no row has a photo, before or after an upload

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Upload a new profile photo for a staff member (their initials > *Edit Profile* > *Click to upload a profile photo*).
# Open *Settings* > *Staff* and reload.
#* The list shows no photos at all.

*Actual Result:*
* The Staff list shows no photos.

*Expected Result:*
* After a reload the staff member's new photo shows.
